age.evidence: Male adult C57BL/6 mice, aged 8 weeks

sex.evidence: Male adult C57BL/6 mice, aged 8 weeks

dosing.evidence: DOI hydrochloride (2.0 mg/kg as hydrochloride salt) ... was administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) to mice 23 h after i.p. administration of saline (10 ml/kg) or LPS (0.5 mg/kg).
lisuride maleate (1.0 mg/kg as maleate salt) ... was administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) to mice 23 h after i.p. administration of saline (10 ml/kg) or LPS (0.5 mg/kg).

group_housing.evidence: housed under controlled temperatures and 12-hour light/dark cycles (lights on between 07:00-19:00 h), with ad libitum food and water

assays.assay_description: Locomotor activity measured in experimental cages (560 × 560 × 330 mm) for 60 min using the SCANETMV-40 animal movement analysis system, 3 h after drug injection.

application_type.evidence: Saline (10 ml/kg), DOI (2.0 mg/kg), lisuride (1.0 mg/kg), or (R)-ketamine (10 mg/kg) was administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) to mice

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were placed in experimental cages (length × width × height: 560 × 560 × 330 mm). The cumulative exercise was recorded for 60 min.

food_restriction.evidence: Locomotion test was performed in experimental cages; no food in the apparatus during the 60-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: Locomotion test was performed in experimental cages; no water in the apparatus during the 60-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: Locomotion test was performed 3 h after injection

sample_size.evidence: Data are shown as mean ± S.E.M (n = 9 or 10). Locomotion test (one-way ANOVA: F4,41 = 1.304, P = 0.285)

outcomes.summary: There were no significant alterations in locomotor activity among the five treatment groups (saline, LPS+saline, LPS+DOI, LPS+lisuride, LPS+(R)-ketamine).
outcomes.evidence: There were no alterations in locomotion among the five groups (Fig. 1B).

B1_num_measures.evidence: The cumulative exercise was recorded for 60 min.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only cumulative exercise reported; no within-session time-course analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually; no social component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: SCANETMV-40 is an automated movement analysis system (position/beam-based tracking), not behavioural classification.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in the testing cage.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse tested individually in the cage.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in testing cage during 60-min recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: Locomotion recorded in a single 60-min session.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The cumulative exercise was recorded for 60 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Locomotion test was performed 3 h after injection (single day).

assays.assay_description: Mice placed individually in a cylinder (23 cm diameter, 31 cm height) with 15 cm water at 23 ± 1 °C; immobility time recorded for 6 min using SCANETMV-40, 3 h after drug injection.

application_type.evidence: Saline (10 ml/kg), DOI (2.0 mg/kg), lisuride (1.0 mg/kg), or (R)-ketamine (10 mg/kg) was administered i.p. to mice

setup_restrain.evidence: FST cylinder is listed as restraint per rubric; mice placed individually in a cylinder containing 15 cm of water.

food_restriction.evidence: FST cylinder contains only water; no food accessible during the 6-min recording.

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water accessible in the FST cylinder during the 6-min recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Forced swimming test (FST) was performed 3 h after injection

sample_size.evidence: Data are shown as mean ± S.E.M (n = 9 or 10). Forced swimming test (one-way ANOVA: F4,42 = 7.899, P < 0.001)

outcomes.summary: Lisuride (1.0 mg/kg) and (R)-ketamine (10 mg/kg) significantly attenuated the LPS-induced increase in FST immobility time, whereas DOI (2.0 mg/kg) did not affect the increased immobility time of LPS-treated mice.
outcomes.evidence: Lisuride and (R)-ketamine significantly attenuated the increase in immobility time of FST in the LPS-treated mice, suggesting a rapid-acting antidepressant-like effect. However, DOI did not affect the increased immobility time of FST in the LPS-treated mice (Fig. 1C).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Immobility time from activity time as (total) - (active) time was calculated by the apparatus analysis software.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total immobility time over 6 min reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No sequential or bout analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility is not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Automated forced-swim apparatus SCANETMV-40 detects activity, not behavioural classification.

E1_environment_type.evidence: cylinder (diameter: 23 cm; height: 31 cm) containing 15 cm of water

E7_social_context.evidence: The mice were placed individually in a cylinder.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/drinking water available during 6-min FST.

D1_continuity.evidence: Immobility recorded for a single 6-min session.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The immobility time for mouse was recorded for 6 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: FST performed once, 3 h after injection.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same two behavioural assays (Locomotion, FST); Golgi staining and spleen weight were correctly excluded as non-behavioural.
B1 set to 0 (single measure) for both assays per modal value and rubric (1 measure → 0 points; glm scored 1 incorrectly).
FST direction set to 'mixed' since lisuride/(R)-ketamine decreased immobility but DOI had no effect; the assay tested multiple psychedelic compounds with opposing/null outcomes.

time_to_assay value bin set to 'acute_0to2h' per rubric (180 min just exceeds 120 min boundary, but multiple candidates differed; chose modal candidate framing — note value_minutes=180 is the authoritative numeric).
setup_restrain for FST scored 'yes' per rubric explicit listing of FST cylinder as restraint.
Housing group_housing set to not_reported — paper does not state cage density (gptoss inferred 'yes' incorrectly from ad lib food/water statement).
